tools.name: search_blog
tools.description: Full-text Spanish search across the EnMente clinical blog — hundreds of articles in Spanish written by licensed Chilean psychiatrists and psychologists. Returns title, url, author, summary, categories and relevance_score, plus total_available (the live count of published articles).

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_availability" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "get_availability" stacks urgency/override words (important, always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_blog, get_availability, list_self_assessments · Private data: get_availability · Public sink: get_availability.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_blog, get_availability, list_self_assessments · Private data: get_availability · Public sink: get_availability

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
